@NickCao would you mind taking another look at this?
Still not very convinced by the make it work out of nixos part (since most of these users would happily use docker instead), but otherwise lgtm.

> Still not very convinced by the make it work out of nixos part (since most of these users would happily use docker instead), but otherwise lgtm.

Yea, it's more for the people who use Nix + another distro already. We'll rewrite this as one of the new modular services at some point in the future anyway.
Well, this also has the benefit of making the module simpler. The `ollama-nextjs-webui` package also has something similar.

@adamcstephens, would you mind taking a look at this? It's part of [the pangolin stack](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/pull/416148), for which you reviewed [olm](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/pull/429561)
Sorry this got lost in my pile of backlog.
No worries, thanks! This unblocks https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/pull/416148, which i will rebase in an hour or so :)

review_comments.body:
Actually, some improvements can be made here.
- We should copy the .next and public folders instead of symlinking them.
- They should automatically update to the binary version being executed (so you don't run Pangolin 1.7.3 with data from 1.5.1)
- There should be some way to skip the directory operations.

Maybe we should also deploy a basic config and call $EDITOR on it if the config doesn't exist.
